Schedule one 2-hour meeting for all attendees at both seats.
A meeting needs two consecutive free 1-hour cells on the same weekday. A start fits your seat only if both cells are free for every attendee at your seat. A joint start must fit both seats.

Slot IDs by weekday and start time:
Day  09:00  10:00  11:00  12:00  13:00  14:00  15:00
Mon      0      1      2      3      4      5      6
Tue      7      8      9     10     11     12     13
Wed     14     15     16     17     18     19     20
Thu     21     22     23     24     25     26     27
Fri     28     29     30     31     32     33     34

Your calendar: 2-hour start IDs that fit all attendees in this view: [9,15,16,17].

Task:
Day IDs: 0 = Mon, 1 = Tue, 2 = Wed, 3 = Thu, 4 = Fri.
Initial report from the other calendar: [14,15,18,19,20,21,22,23,24,25]
Opened weekday reports: {"reports":[{"day":1,"starts":[]},{"day":2,"starts":[15,19,20]}]}
Each opened report replaces the initial list for that weekday. An empty report means the sender listed no start for that weekday; it is not proof none exists. For every other weekday, the initial list is your only information about the other calendar. Select one joint start. Return only JSON: {"slot":n}. Replace n with one slot ID.
Visible intersections: {"opened":[15],"unopened_initial":[]}
Both sets depend on the peer's reports. A listed start can be invalid (a false positive), and a valid start can be absent (a false negative). You may select any slot ID, even if it is not listed in either set.
